source_text: Ego flos campi et lilium convallium. Christus se florem campi dicit, qui in mundo apparuit omnibus; lilium convallium, quia humilibus se praebet. Sicut lilium inter spinas, sic amica mea inter filias: ecclesia candida inter pungentes tribulationes.
pass_a_gloss: I flower of-field and lily of-valleys. Christ himself flower of-field says, who in world appeared to-all; lily of-valleys, because to-humble ones himself he-offers...
pass_b_english: [[I am the flower of the field and the lily of the valleys >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:1]]. Christ calls himself the flower of the field, who appeared in the world for all; the lily of the valleys, because he offers himself to the lowly. [[As a lily among thorns, so is my friend among the daughters >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:2]]: the church bright among piercing tribulations.
